culprit: d65b0bfc Deduplicate Input objects in JSON

parent.subject: All nodes have a source property, not just Root

good.subject: Show error on unknown property in plugin

outcome.failureOutput: WHOBROKEIT_BUG: expected JSON.stringify(root.nodes[0].nodes) to succeed, but it threw TypeError: inputs.get is not a function

explanation.why: In `Node.toJSON` in `lib/node.js`, the commit added an optional `inputs` parameter and treated "no argument" as "this is the top-level call". `JSON.stringify` always calls `toJSON(key)` with the property key as a string, for example `"0"` for array elements. So when you stringify `root.nodes[0].nodes`, each declaration gets `inputs = "0"`. That is not null, so the code never creates a `Map`, and `inputs.get(...)` throws "inputs.get is not a function". The check must be whether `inputs` is actually a `Map`. The per-call `inputsNextIndex = 0` counter also restarts at 0 in every nested call, so I replaced it with `inputs.size`.
